inferences.statement: The available evidence is sufficient for a bounded retrospective of the verified window, but insufficient for a factual 90-day historical retrospective.
limitations: The inference is restricted to source availability and temporal authority.
It does not establish what occurred outside the verified window.

inferences.statement: The evidence model favors explicit proof boundaries over treating repository declarations or file presence as proof of successful execution.
limitations: This describes the evidence policy and observed inventory classification.
It does not establish production readiness or universal execution success.

unknowns: project activity before repository root commit unknown
Verified project history covering the remainder of the nominal 90-day retrospective window is unavailable in the currently authorized evidence set.
